I replied in #coastal-team to Bettina. I did not set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest.

My workspace has no scheduler that can post to this channel. Scheduled jobs from this session only save their output locally and don't post back. So each digest would need a manual request. I offered to post one on request, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random, and I haven't posted one yet.
